g_42dadc189947.title: ISO 8601 duration support in ms (formatting first)

links.evidence: Opening ask "Let's continue with the ISO durations. Parsing is next: parseISO(\"PT1H30M\") should return 5400000, i.e. the inverse of formatISO" continues the open formatISO request (formatISO(5400000) = "PT1H30M").

anchorAsk.text: I want ISO 8601 duration support in ms, starting with formatting: `formatISO(5400000)` should give "PT1H30M" and `formatISO(90061000)` "P1DT1H1M1S". Days are the largest unit, no months or years since those are ambiguous. Export it from src/index.ts and add tests.
Separate PR: add `parseCompound` for strings like "1h 30m" or "2 days 4 hours", returning the total in ms, NaN if it can't be parsed. Export it from src/index.ts with tests.
